    budget = case['budget']

    sum_min = sum(s['minimum'] for s in segments)
    sum_cap = sum(s['capacity'] for s in segments)
    if budget < sum_min or budget > sum_cap:
        return {'error': 'Budget out of range'}

    alloc = {s['name']: s['minimum'] for s in segments}
    remaining = budget - sum_min
    # list of segments for order
    seg_list = segments  # maintain order

            name = s['name']
            next_pos = alloc[name] + 1
            if next_pos > s['capacity']:

            if ratio > best_ratio:

        remaining -= 1
    return {

        'names': [s['name'] for s in seg_list],
        'total_allocated': sum(alloc.values())
